name: cache-meter
description: Stop wasting tokens: keeps the prompt cache warm through every break, shows when it expires and what each answer costs.

cacheTtl.title: Cache TTL
cacheTtl.description: auto: follows Claude Code's TTL controls and your plan state, else 60m (full order: docs/how-it-works.md). 60m or 5m: fixed – wins over everything.

autoSidebar.title: Sidebar at start
autoSidebar.description: auto: in the fullscreen renderer (/tui fullscreen), the /tokens dashboard opens as a sidebar at session start (from 144 columns, 110 once you opened it) and stays closed once you close it – never above the prompt. off: only with /tokens.

turnLine.title: Line under each answer
turnLine.description: on: one line under each answer – its cost (subagents included), requests, share from the cache and tokens written to it. off: no line.

expiryNotice.title: Notification before the cache expires
expiryNotice.description: on: a terminal notification through your own notification channel about 10 minutes before a one-hour cache expires while keepwarm is off – once per cache window, from 10k tokens of context. off: none.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: on: in the docked dashboard a small café acts out the cache; on the Overview the minute flashes, new columns grow in, figures count up and the keepwarm arrow turns – brief, only while the Overview shows. The animation files get only the cache's state. off: none of it.

limitNotice.title: Notification when a plan limit fills up
limitNotice.description: on: a terminal notification through your own notification channel when a plan limit (5 hours, 7 days, spend limit) is half used and on course to fill before it resets – once per window. The toast comes either way. off: the toast only.

sessionBudget.title: Session budget ($)
sessionBudget.description: 0 = off. A dollar budget for this session against the figure the band shows (spend, or API value on a subscription): it reads "of $X", turns yellow at 80 % and red at 100 %, with one toast at each.
